suite: Banzami Phase 0 — Pilot Limit Policy: Live-API Sandbox Functional Evidence
plan: Plano de Teste Detalhado Banzami V1.0
completion: COMPLETE (material) — pilot-enabled Sandbox redeploy + live-API synthetic end-to-end. Every API-reachable pilot limit proven live with no-balance/no-ledger-mutation on rejection. Three caps that are structurally shadowed by an equal-or-lower cap at the API layer (merchant per-received, merchant max balance) or impractical to drive at API volume (aggregate volume) are covered by merged real-DB integration tests.
scope_note: Internal technical Sandbox only. Synthetic participants and balances only. No real money, customers, external providers, public access, LIVE, Production or BNA claim. Live-API calls were made over the internal-only network via `docker exec <service> curl` against the deployed pilot-enabled Sandbox. Auth was bootstrapped by minting SANDBOX JWTs with the Sandbox's own signing secret held only in volatile memory (never logged, persisted, committed or reported). No secrets, tokens, IDs, hostnames, IPs or paths are recorded.

runtime_enforcement.evidence: F0-014 — PILOT_LIMIT_CONSUMER_DAILY_EXCEEDED after cumulative >50.000/day; balances unchanged
F0-005 — PILOT_LIMIT_CONSUMER_BALANCE_EXCEEDED on credit past 50.000; balance unchanged

Real-DB integration test (pilot_enforcement_integration.rs). Not independently triggerable at API level: the per-received cap (25.000) equals the consumer per-payment cap (25.000), so a single receipt >25.000 is blocked on the payer side first.
F0-015 — PILOT_LIMIT_MERCHANT_DAILY_EXCEEDED after cumulative receiving >100.000/day; merchant balance unchanged on rejection
Real-DB integration test. Shadowed at API level by the merchant daily-receiving cap (both 100.000): the daily cap trips on the same crossing receipt and is evaluated first.
F0-016 — PILOT_LIMIT_AGGREGATE_FUNDS_EXCEEDED once system funds-in-circulation exceeded 500.000; rejected wallet balance unchanged
Real-DB integration test. Impractical to drive at API volume: reaching 2.000.000 in payments requires ~80+ payments while consumer per-payment (25.000) and daily (50.000) caps throttle throughput.

pilot_enforcement_integration_tests.note: real-DB allow/reject per cap; asserts no ledger mutation on rejection
